recognize_zh: 高倍 LAP 染色：兩顆中性球核呈紅色分葉，細胞質布滿中等密度的藍色顆粒但核仍清楚可見，大約屬於 2–3 分的陽性強度。
features: Two segmented neutrophils with red-counterstained multilobed nuclei
Moderately dense, fine blue granular reaction product throughout the cytoplasm
Nuclear outlines remain clearly visible (not obscured)
Unstained red cells forming aggregates in background
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase shows two segmented neutrophils with moderately dense, evenly distributed blue cytoplasmic granules. The red-stained nuclear lobes remain clearly discernible through the reaction product. These cells illustrate intermediate positivity, approximately 2+ to 3+ on the 0 to 4+ LAP scoring scale.

ddx.vs: 1+ cells show only scattered, sparse faint granules with most cytoplasm unstained.
4+ cells show intense confluent dark blue staining that obscures the nucleus.
